This implies that Cisplatin may modulate the activity of Slc31a2, potentially through the regulation of copper homeostasis. The observed pathway highlights a possible mechanism by which Cisplatin could influence cellular processes involving Slc31a2, though the exact nature of this interaction remains to be fully elucidated. The evidence supports a mechanistic link between Cisplatin and Slc31a2, but further experimental validation is required to confirm the direct role of Atp7b in this relationship.
